record.question: Who was the first President of Mizoram Library Association?
record.explanation: The printed question and options on page 2 are clear. A search-indexed Mizo historical account explicitly names Pu C. Lianzama, Librarian of Mizoram State Library, as the first president ("President hmasa ber"); however, the full account could not be retrieved and no association record independently confirming this was located, so this remains tentative. Source: https://information2933.rssing.com/chan-25021459/all_p5.html
